scope.method: Pinned Git blobs only. Package/import inventory plus selected workflows and tests; not an exhaustive correctness audit.
scope.model: Cohesive actions/<service> packages own explicit workflows and projections. CLI owns command UX, app constructs dependencies, and internal mechanisms retain real safety or integration boundaries. No universal runner or action-to-action dependencies.

package_decisions.role: Command service facade; destination entry file actions/auth/check.go.
package_decisions.import_shape: errs and commandhint; consumer-owned environment/authenticator interfaces.
package_decisions.rationale: Explicit live PAT verification; retain source provenance and failure output.
package_decisions.preserve: Live sign-in, no automatic persistence, request IDs, exact target.

package_decisions.role: Command service facade; destination entry file actions/auth/login.go.
package_decisions.import_shape: errs plus bounded resolver/authenticator/store interfaces.
package_decisions.rationale: Login shares a service owner with check, status, and logout without sharing their mutation sequence.
package_decisions.preserve: Terminal boundary, authenticated identity, keyring/config ordering, redacted input, installed-state reporting.

package_decisions.role: Command service facade; destination entry file actions/auth/logout.go.
package_decisions.import_shape: errs; resolver and credential-removal interfaces.
package_decisions.rationale: Local credential removal belongs in the same auth facade, with distinct preview and compensation.
package_decisions.preserve: No Tableau revocation, selected reference only, orphan recovery, post-save deletion.

package_decisions.role: Command service facade; destination entry file actions/auth/status.go.
package_decisions.import_shape: errs and commandhint; config resolver and environment lookup.
package_decisions.rationale: Local readiness is an auth operation, not an independent package boundary.
package_decisions.preserve: No network/keyring read, unverified stored reference, partial environment pair semantics.

package_decisions.role: Command service facade; destination entry file actions/env/profile.go.
package_decisions.import_shape: config for external variable validation, errs/output/commandhint; per-consumer store ports.
package_decisions.rationale: Already cohesive across profile verbs; remove the extra namespace level rather than recreate verb packages.
package_decisions.preserve: Stored versus effective defaults, exact aliases, ordered changed fields, preview non-mutation.

package_decisions.role: Command service facade; destination entry file actions/cache/refresh.go.
package_decisions.import_shape: errs/output/value/commandhint; Hydrator port.
package_decisions.rationale: Refresh and status share generation/readiness vocabulary; keep collection and inspection distinct.
package_decisions.preserve: Scope closure, scope-plan agreement, permission gaps, bounded receipt validation, read-only preview.

package_decisions.role: Command service facade; destination entry file actions/cache/status.go.
package_decisions.import_shape: errs/output/value/commandhint; Source port.
package_decisions.rationale: Status belongs beside refresh; merging packages does not imply shared HTTP behavior.
package_decisions.preserve: Uninitialized state, retained observations, stale/incomplete distinctions, projection bounds.

package_decisions.role: Command service facade; destination entry file actions/workspace/workspace.go.
package_decisions.import_shape: errs/output/commandhint and narrow filesystem/registry ports; no concrete manager dependency.
package_decisions.rationale: Already a cohesive service. Replace excessive app coordination, not this package with verb folders.
package_decisions.preserve: Workspace/artifact identity, dirty checks, partial persistence, operation-specific projections.

package_decisions.role: Command service facade; destination entry file actions/agent/install.go.
package_decisions.import_shape: agenttarget/errs/value; Installer port.
package_decisions.rationale: Guidance installation/uninstallation share supported-target and result vocabulary.
package_decisions.preserve: Auto install only, home-relative backup paths, retained partial package state, explicit force semantics.

package_decisions.role: Command service facade; destination entry file actions/agent/uninstall.go.
package_decisions.import_shape: agenttarget/errs/value; Uninstaller port.
package_decisions.rationale: Place uninstall beside install but keep narrower supported target and output contract.
package_decisions.preserve: No auto uninstall, preservation of edited packages, incomplete rollback evidence.

package_decisions.role: Command service facade; destination entry file actions/update/action.go.
package_decisions.import_shape: errs and Runtime port; does not call agent/version actions.
package_decisions.rationale: Already one cohesive update facade. It coordinates binary plus Guidance update, not just release lookup.
package_decisions.preserve: Check-only mode, same-version Guidance refresh, target order, partial install uncertainty.

package_decisions.role: Command service facade; destination entry file actions/doctor/run.go.
package_decisions.import_shape: errs/commandhint; six probe interfaces with independent behavior.
package_decisions.rationale: Flatten the single run package; keep explicit prerequisite graph and independent probes.
package_decisions.preserve: Blocked versus failed probes, secret-safe diagnostics, connectivity distinct from local readiness.

package_decisions.role: Command service facade; destination entry file actions/policy/install.go.
package_decisions.import_shape: errs/value now; inject managed-policy mechanism and definitions without importing capability actions.
package_decisions.rationale: Cohesive folder currently owns validation/projections while actual tool workflows remain in app. Move those workflows here.
package_decisions.preserve: Privilege boundary, recovery exemptions, no activation by validate/samples, partial effects.

package_decisions.role: Command service facade; destination entry file actions/capability/get.go.
package_decisions.import_shape: internal/capability plus errs; source port.
package_decisions.rationale: Exact lookup and bounded listing are one discovery service.
package_decisions.preserve: Exact IDs, delegated contracts, policy overlay, discovery never authorizes execution.

package_decisions.role: Command service facade; destination entry file actions/capability/list.go.
package_decisions.import_shape: internal/capability/output/errs/commandhint; source port.
package_decisions.rationale: Share discovery ownership and types; retain list-specific paging/filter behavior.
package_decisions.preserve: Source order, bounded all mode, filter-preserving continuation, truthful totals.

package_decisions.role: Command service facade; destination entry file actions/version/get.go.
package_decisions.import_shape: errs and ReleaseChecker port.
package_decisions.rationale: Flatten single operation; do not merge passive version query with active update.
package_decisions.preserve: Offline default, dev-version behavior, installed version on lookup failure.

package_decisions.role: Command service facade; destination entry file actions/last/action.go.
package_decisions.import_shape: errs/value and Reader; no action-to-action calls.
package_decisions.rationale: Keep saved-result replay facade and bring replay authorization out of app.
package_decisions.preserve: No operation/network replay, saved full document, policy checks for original and prerequisite capabilities.

package_decisions.role: Command service facade; destination entry file actions/session/overview.go.
package_decisions.import_shape: value and Reader now; explicit local config/workspace/readiness dependencies after migration.
package_decisions.rationale: Flatten the overview package and give it ownership of local overview assembly currently in app.
package_decisions.preserve: No authentication claim, bounded projections, deterministic order, no setup writes.

package_decisions.role: Focused ownership change, not whole-package relocation.
package_decisions.import_shape: config and internal/auth infrastructure; no other action service.
package_decisions.rationale: Move credential/config coordination and target checks into the auth service with explicit transaction and PATStore dependencies; retain core keyring/session implementation.
package_decisions.preserve: Keep rollback before unlock, post-save deletion, cancellation-resistant cleanup, fresh persisted target comparison.

package_decisions.role: Focused ownership change, not whole-package relocation.
package_decisions.import_shape: golang.org/x/term and IO only.
package_decisions.rationale: Terminal prompting is command UX, not composition or credential storage.
package_decisions.preserve: Hidden secret entry and stderr prompts; never introduce secret flags.

package_decisions.role: Focused ownership change, not whole-package relocation.
package_decisions.import_shape: config persistence and service-owned records; avoid importing auth actions from env.
package_decisions.rationale: Move configProfileStore CRUD/default rules and profile projections into env with explicit config access. Keep construction and registry labels in app; authStatusResolver moves to auth.
package_decisions.preserve: Preview uses no write/lock; stored credential target/removal guards; get/list default distinction.

package_decisions.role: Focused ownership change, not whole-package relocation.
package_decisions.import_shape: Named cache workflow with an injected inventory port; no actions import of internal/tableau or resources.
package_decisions.rationale: Move requested refresh policy and the named refresh workflow to actions/cache. Internal/inventory owns neutral generation, collection, and publication coordination. App constructs the authenticated executor and binds dependencies without retaining refresh policy.
package_decisions.preserve: Permission checks before requests and after default scope expansion, requested/actual scope distinctions, and operation-specific output.

package_decisions.role: Neutral generation, collection, and publication coordination shared below action workflows.
package_decisions.import_shape: Injected native collector and core cache store; no action types or domain action imports. App constructs the authenticated executor.
package_decisions.rationale: Keep generation staging, collection-plan validation, collected coverage, publication, and rollback in internal/inventory. The native collector retains Tableau protocol behavior, and internal/cache retains storage. Consumers use explicit ports without importing Tableau from actions.
package_decisions.preserve: Checks before requests, actual scope ledger, staged publication/rollback, incomplete permissions not empty rules, per-environment concurrency.

package_decisions.role: Focused ownership change, not whole-package relocation.
package_decisions.import_shape: config/cache/workspace/artifact mechanisms; no actions/auth or actions/workspace imports.
package_decisions.rationale: Move local probe implementations alongside their doctor workflow with explicit config/cache/workspace dependencies. Inject connectivity rather than invoking auth action.
package_decisions.preserve: Independent checks, prerequisite ordering, local presence versus authenticated access, bounded inventory.

package_decisions.role: Focused ownership change, not whole-package relocation.
package_decisions.import_shape: config, internal/auth readiness, workspace selection, value records.
package_decisions.rationale: Move local overview aggregation out of runtimeDependencies. Use lower-level readiness and workspace selection dependencies, not auth/status action output as a service API.
package_decisions.preserve: Missing config stays local, no writes/sign-in, exact site consent, unverified credential reference.

package_decisions.role: Focused ownership change, not whole-package relocation.
package_decisions.import_shape: Environment lookup and nonsecret reference facts only; no keyring read or action imports.
package_decisions.rationale: Extract nonsecret source-presence observation shared by auth status, session, and doctor. Leave command help and output assembly in actions/auth. This removes the existing session-to-auth facade dependency without a generic service graph.
package_decisions.preserve: Do not silently harmonize different diagnostic wording or whitespace policies during movement; characterize each consumer.

package_decisions.role: Focused ownership change, not whole-package relocation.
package_decisions.import_shape: internal/workspace and internal/artifact mechanisms through explicit dependencies.
package_decisions.rationale: Move default-root choice, inventory/dirty policy, and operation outcome composition to workspace service with explicit manager/artifact ports. Keep immutable record projections local rather than app-owned adapters.
package_decisions.preserve: Fresh root/ID and dirty-state revalidation before deletion, force semantics, partial outcomes, relative artifacts.

package_decisions.role: Focused ownership change, not whole-package relocation.
package_decisions.import_shape: Filesystem and path primitives; no action imports.
package_decisions.rationale: Place bounded rooted traversal and unmanaged-entry classification with filesystem workspace mechanics, accepting managed relative paths from the caller.
package_decisions.preserve: Traversal bound, symlink/root protection, cancellation, existing recognized artifact paths.

package_decisions.role: Focused ownership change, not whole-package relocation.
package_decisions.import_shape: internal/managedpolicy and internal/capability definitions; no capability action dependency.
package_decisions.rationale: Move InstallManagedPolicy, status counts, candidate validation, sample writing, and error/outcome mapping to policy service.
package_decisions.preserve: Protected installation phases, recovery usability, bounded candidate reads, exclusive sample creation, confirmed partial writes.

package_decisions.role: Focused ownership change, not whole-package relocation.
package_decisions.import_shape: internal/lastcommand and value; policy checker port rather than actions/policy.
package_decisions.rationale: Move replay prerequisite authorization and legacy snapshot checks into last workflow using injected capability checks.
package_decisions.preserve: Check original operation plus captured prerequisites; do not weaken historical search snapshot handling.

package_decisions.role: Focused ownership change, not whole-package relocation.
package_decisions.import_shape: Cobra plus checker and capability metadata dependencies; policy evaluation stays below CLI.
package_decisions.rationale: Place Cobra dispatch wrapper with command execution boundary; app installs it in the existing order and supplies policy evaluator/ledger.
package_decisions.preserve: Deny before launching workers; independently load policy in workers; preserve recovery operations and preview allowance.

package_decisions.role: Focused ownership change, not whole-package relocation.
package_decisions.import_shape: internal/capability and checker port; no actions/policy imports.
package_decisions.rationale: Move discovery overlay from runtime-bound adapter to discovery service with injected definitions and policy checks. Keep registry binding/bootstrap in app.
package_decisions.preserve: List/get use same managed overlay; blocked discovery remains visible; discovery is not authorization.

package_decisions.role: Focused ownership change, not whole-package relocation.
package_decisions.import_shape: internal/version is already shared by updater and notices; no new leaf package needed.
package_decisions.rationale: Use the existing internal/version.Release as the checker result contract, eliminating field-for-field releaseChecker.Latest mapping. Keep external version output operation-owned.
package_decisions.preserve: Version/URL/published-time fields and timestamps; no broadened serialized output.

package_decisions.role: Focused ownership change, not whole-package relocation.
package_decisions.import_shape: lastcommand/output/value; no app/runtime dependency.
package_decisions.rationale: Move bounded snapshot/capture persistence to saved-execution infrastructure with explicit clock, prerequisite snapshot, and config-hint inputs. Keep command completion hookup in app.
package_decisions.preserve: Save failure does not reverse completed operation; receipt bound, two-second cleanup context, no stale expansion claim.

package_decisions.role: Focused ownership change, not whole-package relocation.
package_decisions.import_shape: config only; internal/update retains environment filtering and process execution.
package_decisions.rationale: Expose configured variable-name enumeration from config; app binds it to updater callback after root config flags resolve.
package_decisions.preserve: Load names at child startup, never load values, unreadable config fallback remains explicit.

package_decisions.role: Focused ownership change, not whole-package relocation.
package_decisions.import_shape: capability definitions and managedpolicy helper only.
package_decisions.rationale: This entry point is already a small composition boundary wiring definitions to the scoped privileged helper.
package_decisions.preserve: Do not initialize ordinary config, saved credentials, sessions, or publication workers.

package_decisions.role: PAT references, native credential storage, session lifetime and source resolution.
package_decisions.import_shape: Infrastructure below action services; see evidence for sampled dependencies.
package_decisions.rationale: Keep facade actions/auth distinct from credential/session infrastructure. Add only shared nonsecret readiness here.
package_decisions.preserve: Target binding, redaction, native failure classification, session isolation.

package_decisions.role: Schema, locked update, preview, migration, and persistence outcome primitive.
package_decisions.import_shape: Infrastructure below action services; see evidence for sampled dependencies.
package_decisions.rationale: Shared by auth/env/workspace; not an actions/env implementation detail.
package_decisions.preserve: Fresh reads, lock ordering, rollback, installed-but-not-durable markers.

package_decisions.role: Rooted filesystem and registry transaction mechanics.
package_decisions.import_shape: Infrastructure below action services; see evidence for sampled dependencies.
package_decisions.rationale: Distinct from actions/workspace UX/workflow/projections; retain both with explicit interfaces.
package_decisions.preserve: Symlink protection, stable manifest identity, rollback consistency.

package_decisions.role: Artifact inventory, manifests, and file operations shared with content workflows.
package_decisions.import_shape: Infrastructure below action services; see evidence for sampled dependencies.
package_decisions.rationale: Retain mechanism; do not import workspace action for artifact handling.
package_decisions.preserve: Resource-specific artifact contracts and containment; full package audit deferred.

package_decisions.role: SQLite generation, staging, resource snapshots, and persistence.
package_decisions.import_shape: Infrastructure below action services; see evidence for sampled dependencies.
package_decisions.rationale: Keep shared store below cache command and resource read consumers.
package_decisions.preserve: Generation atomicity, bounded queries, partial coverage, unrelated-environment write progress.

package_decisions.role: Collector scope plan and remote collection engine.
package_decisions.import_shape: Infrastructure below action services; see evidence for sampled dependencies.
package_decisions.rationale: Keep API traversal below actions/cache; do not merge remote collector and SQLite implementation.
package_decisions.preserve: Collected/requested/implicit scope differences and policy preconditions.

package_decisions.role: Guidance package plan, backups, rooted installation/uninstallation and rollback.
package_decisions.import_shape: Infrastructure below action services; see evidence for sampled dependencies.
package_decisions.rationale: Retain meaningful filesystem engine rather than relocating all installation into actions/agent.
package_decisions.preserve: Edited package backups, partial rollback states, staged commits, no unrelated deletions.

package_decisions.role: Shared supported agent names and destination conventions.
package_decisions.import_shape: Infrastructure below action services; see evidence for sampled dependencies.
package_decisions.rationale: Used by Guidance install, update target validation, and notices; do not place under an action.
package_decisions.preserve: Exact supported target names and target paths.

package_decisions.role: Release resolution, installer invocation, bounded process execution and child environment isolation.
package_decisions.import_shape: Infrastructure below action services; see evidence for sampled dependencies.
package_decisions.rationale: Retain updater infrastructure; actions/update owns user-facing sequence/outcomes. Existing inward use of action.Release must be aligned to common record convention, not hidden with forwarding packages.
package_decisions.preserve: Pinned release, absolute system executable, PAT filtering, process-tree cancellation, partial rollback honesty.

package_decisions.role: Installed build identity and remote release lookup.
package_decisions.import_shape: Infrastructure below action services; see evidence for sampled dependencies.
package_decisions.rationale: Retain shared release mechanism and Release record; passive version, active update, and notices remain separate consumers.
package_decisions.preserve: Offline installed identity, dirty provenance, bounded release fetch.

package_decisions.role: Protected policy parsing, native trust checks, elevation, locator and install transaction.
package_decisions.import_shape: Infrastructure below action services; see evidence for sampled dependencies.
package_decisions.rationale: Retain platform-specific trust boundary; actions/policy adds operation sequencing/presentation, not OS ACL implementations.
package_decisions.preserve: Privilege separation, lock/prepare/write/verify/publish order, confirmed effect receipts.

package_decisions.role: Capability definitions, discovery records, generation, and binding validation.
package_decisions.import_shape: Infrastructure below action services; see evidence for sampled dependencies.
package_decisions.rationale: Retain registry mechanism below CLI/policy/discovery consumers.
package_decisions.preserve: Missing/duplicate/nonimplemented command checks; generated outputs are not manually edited.

package_decisions.role: Bounded saved-execution read/write and atomic replacement.
package_decisions.import_shape: Infrastructure below action services; see evidence for sampled dependencies.
package_decisions.rationale: Retain persistence distinct from actions/last replay decisions; absorb explicit capture mechanism.
package_decisions.preserve: Locks, byte limits, saved prerequisite ledger, original results.

package_decisions.role: Session-scoped missing-Guidance notice eligibility and detection.
package_decisions.import_shape: Infrastructure below action services; see evidence for sampled dependencies.
package_decisions.rationale: Retain cross-cutting notice mechanism; it does not install Guidance or call actions/agent.
package_decisions.preserve: Suppression rules and per-session behavior; only public entrypoints/imports sampled.

package_decisions.role: Optional asynchronous release-notice lifecycle.
package_decisions.import_shape: Infrastructure below action services; see evidence for sampled dependencies.
package_decisions.rationale: Retain separately from explicit version/update commands.
package_decisions.preserve: Eligibility, bounded cached lookup, success-gated notice; full behavior review deferred.

package_decisions.role: Atomic filesystem replacement and installed-but-not-durable distinction.
package_decisions.import_shape: Infrastructure below action services; see evidence for sampled dependencies.
package_decisions.rationale: Retain shared leaf used by config, keyring coordination consumers, Guidance, and saved results.
package_decisions.preserve: Windows sharing retries and Unix directory sync; never merge into one service.

package_decisions.role: Embedded supported bootstrap installers and their test harnesses.
package_decisions.import_shape: Infrastructure below action services; see evidence for sampled dependencies.
package_decisions.rationale: Retain bootstrappers and embedding entrypoint; updater must reuse them rather than introduce a second installer.
package_decisions.preserve: Same release installer path and platform scripts; script internals not reassessed.

workflow_examples.observation: Authentication and local persistence are separate effects. Shared config outcome is consumed by workspace too.
workflow_examples.proposal: One actions/auth facade with explicit persistence coordinator; preserve distinct infra ownership.

workflow_examples.observation: App owns field changes, stored-credential target guard, defaults, and locked persistence despite action facade.
workflow_examples.proposal: actions/env owns profile rules and store coordination; internal/config owns transaction. Remove verb package namespace but retain projections.

workflow_examples.observation: Collection has two scope-plan trust boundaries and staged database publication. Network collection must not lock unrelated writes.
workflow_examples.proposal: Actions/cache owns refresh policy and the named workflow. Internal/inventory owns neutral generation, collection, and publication through injected native collector and core store dependencies. App constructs the authenticated executor; content actions never import actions/cache or Tableau.

workflow_examples.observation: Guidance package preservation and binary installer execution are distinct mechanisms. Update reuses embedded scripts and refreshes Guidance even at same version.
workflow_examples.proposal: Merge Guidance action packages only; retain package installer, updater process boundary, and common target metadata.

workflow_examples.observation: App converts native phases into confirmed effects and recovery while action package mostly validates input.
workflow_examples.proposal: Move operation and outcome ownership to actions/policy, keep native elevation/ACL/locator machinery in internal/managedpolicy.

workflow_examples.observation: Session imports another action for local readiness; doctor independently derives source readiness. Doctor connectivity is intentional; bare overview is local-only.
workflow_examples.proposal: Share nonsecret readiness observation below both facades; retain service-specific projection and probe prerequisites.

workflow_examples.observation: Saved results must recheck capability prerequisites without rerunning the original task. Discovery overlays describe policy but do not authorize.
workflow_examples.proposal: actions/last owns replay policy through a checker; actions/capability owns discovery overlay; shared registry/policy remain infrastructure.

test_findings.contract: Preview validates add/update/remove/default including credential guards without changing config/cache/lock state.
test_findings.assertions: Actual CLI and temporary filesystem snapshot; excludes operational last-result receipt from comparison.
test_findings.limitations: Local snapshots do not establish concurrent writer behavior.
test_findings.disposition: keep; move focused store tests with actions/env, retain CLI integration

test_findings.contract: Reject scope mismatch, absolute paths, inconsistent counts, and failed requests.
test_findings.assertions: Controlled Hydrator results must yield cache.refresh.incomplete.
test_findings.limitations: Fake receipt test does not prove collector or store creates correct receipt.

test_findings.contract: Network collection must not hold the active cache write lock.
test_findings.assertions: Paused fake collector, real temporary store, concurrent other-environment write must finish before collection resumes.
test_findings.limitations: Timed local test, not full distributed contention proof.
test_findings.disposition: relocate with neutral collection/publication coordination in internal/inventory; retain store-level coverage

test_findings.contract: Partial failure retains completed targets and exact full/compact output.
test_findings.assertions: Fake partial installer result plus error; checks structured cause and exact serialized fields.
test_findings.limitations: Does not prove filesystem state; pair with installer recovery test.

test_findings.contract: Failed commit and rollback preserve edited packages at reported backup paths.
test_findings.assertions: Real temporary filesystem with selected rename failures; asserts status and restored/backup file bytes.
test_findings.limitations: Injected OS error, not native lock reproduction on every platform.

test_findings.contract: Validate before release/install, retain target/version and honest failure phase.
test_findings.assertions: Recording runtime asserts exact call sequence, not-attempted versus incomplete status, error cause/outcome.
test_findings.limitations: Fake runtime does not prove binary installation.

test_findings.contract: Updater child excludes configured/conventional PAT variables while retaining needed environment.
test_findings.assertions: Real helper subprocess records variable names; asserts withheld and retained sets.
test_findings.limitations: Helper subprocess is not installer execution or every platform.

test_findings.contract: Failed PAT prerequisite blocks connectivity but not independent checks; diagnostics omit secrets.
test_findings.assertions: Fake probes track calls and inject secret-bearing error; asserts counts and serialized redaction.
test_findings.limitations: Does not prove native probe behavior.

test_findings.contract: Verification failure must preserve confirmed protection/write/active effects and recovery.
test_findings.assertions: Constructed native outcome mapped to structured error; asserts phase, unknown outcome, completed fields, cause.
test_findings.limitations: Projection-only test does not prove native ACL/elevation/locator behavior.

test_findings.contract: Mutation discovery remains visible without enabling execution.
test_findings.assertions: Fake registry records; asserts filtered identity and ExecutionEnabled metadata.
test_findings.limitations: Does not prove runtime policy enforcement; retain binding and enforcement suites.

test_findings.contract: Ordinary version lookup does not contact release provider.
test_findings.assertions: Checker call count zero and installed version/status.
test_findings.limitations: Does not validate release HTTP behavior.

test_findings.contract: Saved-result expansion cannot rerun network work or alter subsequent replay.
test_findings.assertions: Actual command path and network spy; parses JSON and checks repeated full replay equality.
test_findings.limitations: Initial firstDocument is parsed but not compared to lastDocument; title does not prove equality with original output. Operational saved schema differs from compact output.

limits: Proposed architecture, not approved implementation. No tests, live services, production edits, source checkout, or installer/keyring operations performed.
All 18 action packages across 12 requested families have role/import mappings. Supporting package review is selective, not complete coverage of every file or test.
Auth persistence detail reuses the pinned auth-pilot ledger. AUTH-03 remains an unconfirmed correctness concern, not an architecture justification or silently approved fix.

Flatten package namespaces by adapting real callers/tests and removing old packages, not compatibility forwarding packages. Prefix operation-specific types as needed; do not unify externally different projections.
App source files containing multiple responsibilities require symbol-level splits. Unrelated app code is outside these mappings.

Resource-specific cached read adapters in internal/app/cache_reads.go are inventoried but not reassessed end-to-end here. The common proposal places neutral read-through and multi-resource inventory orchestration in internal/inventory without action types, and typed consumer projection in resources/<resource>. Keep these mechanisms below actions/cache and avoid action-to-action imports. This placement is a coordinated proposal, not independently verified end-to-end by this assessment.

Existing internal/update imports actions/update for Release. Prefer a shared lower-level release record under internal/version when adapting this seam; verify URL/version validation remains unchanged and do not create a reverse action dependency.

Guidance and release notice internals, bootstrap script internals, native policy platform implementations, terminal behavior, and all native credential/permission matrices remain separately assessed work.
Shared readiness extraction must preserve current consumer-specific meanings and input normalization. Any correction of inconsistent whitespace or source labels requires a deliberate behavior change.
Retain architecture/security checks unless revised as an explicit approved design decision; counts and fewer files are not acceptance criteria.
